title: CA125 reduction as a potential predictive marker of radiological response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in advanced unresectable endometrial cancer.
snippet: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) followed by interval cytoreductive surgery is increasingly used in advanced endometrial cancer patients not amenable for primary surgery.
